purpose: Experiment 4 original question: N3 (final Exp 3 constrained redesign) vs N4 (EXP4N normalized leader) under the SAME EXP4N certification contract. Additive; EXPERIMENT4_NORMALIZED_CLOSEOUT.md and the EXP4N ranking are not reopened.

justifications.cardinality: How many lines the network activates. Part of the treatment: service activation, including OFF, is a decision variable in this experiment.
justifications.members: Which lines it activates. Part of the treatment.
justifications.pathset_digest: A different route structure has different shortest paths. Requiring identical path sets would admit only a comparison of a network with itself. The path-set POLICY is an identity field of its own and must still match exactly -- that is what stops one arm being enumerated differently from the other.
justifications.state_digest: The network itself. This IS the treatment.
justifications.state_key: The network's name. Follows from state_digest.

contract.search_allowance: NOT APPLICABLE: firewall.exp4.EXP4_ALLOWANCE is an evaluation budget for the Gen2 exchange search. The block certifier's entitlement is n_keys/k_rungs/max_rounds plus the no-improving-round stop rule, network-independent and carried as identity in the solver policy name. EXP4N never used compare_exp4 either.

certify_call.start: gen1 greedy 20000/1/0 inside certify (treatment-independent; no warm start from N4)

N4.result_source: EXP4N production_mr120 (authoritative); re-run here ONLY as the equivalence canary

N3.provenance: pre_exp4_baseline_v1 incumbent singleton; its historical score is provenance only
N3.representation_bridge: exp4_assemble.rebuild_like_assembler vs legacy at certify's first step (D34)

requires: firewall admit() under this contract digest

delta43: obj(N4) - obj(N3), with components generalized_cost, unserved_demand, served_demand, revenue_veh_hours, peak proxy
